     1	import dlt

     5	spark = SparkSession.getActiveSession()

     7	# Create the streaming table to maintain SCD Type 2 history
     8	dlt.create_streaming_table("consumer_mv_history")
     9	
    10	# Apply CDC from the landing stream
    11	dlt.apply_changes(
    12	    target="consumer_mv_history",
    13	    source=dlt.read("consumer_cdc_stream"),
    14	    keys=["consumer_id"],
    15	    sequence_by=col("ingestion_time"),
    16	    apply_as_deletes=col("operation") == "delete",
    17	    except_column_list=["operation", "ingestion_time"],
    18	    stored_as_scd_type=2
    19	)
    20	
    21	# Bronze materialized view: current records with columns dropped
    22	@dlt.table(
    23	    name="consumer_mv",
    24	    comment="Bronze view with current consumer records",
    25	    table_properties={"quality": "bronze"}
    26	)
    27	def consumer_mv():
    28	    df = dlt.read("consumer_mv_history")
    29	    # Filter to current active records
    30	    df_filtered = df.filter("__START_AT IS NOT NULL AND __END_AT IS NULL")
    31	    # Drop SCD metadata columns
    32	    columns_to_drop = ["__START_AT", "__END_AT", "__OPERATION"]
    33	    return df_filtered.drop(*columns_to_drop)
